So I was bored because I've been grounded for about three months and going to the comic book store was my first time out of the house besides school. I saw this family playing MTG so I decided to do some research, found out it was pretty cool and bought a dual l deck then a deck builders toolkit. Looking back on it, I probably shouldn't have but new stuff and should of looked on ebay or something for a set. Either way I'm having fun.

Just a heads up, It can get very costly if you want to start getting into local tournaments. Not the cost of the tournament. The cost to give your deck a solid chance.

Besides that, It's quite fun to get into and just play a bit with friends and family.
Yea my goal was just to get my brother in law into it so I can casually play with someone. Idt I want to play competitively
Closed Deck tournaments are a fun way to build up a card collection while getting to meet and compete against other players.

MtG is a good hobby if you can afford it. Don't expect to be able to build a top tier deck without spending at least $200. I would suggest finding friends to play with casually because entering a FNM at a game shop with a bad deck will generally (depending on how serious the store is about competition) result in you getting dominated. Good luck and feel free to join us in https://voat.co/v/mtg if you have any questions.
